en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a street corner with a large, ornate late-19th/early-20th-century building at the junction of two tree-lined streets. Signs on the corner advertise a bakery-confectionery and a tailor shop. A cyclist rides along the street in the foreground and a woman walks on the sidewalk. Printed red text at the top left identifies the location as Radebeul-Oberlößnitz and the streets Carola- und Albertstrasse. A vertical red imprint at the right margin notes the publisher.
